app.title: SWAGcleaner
app.subtitle: Tidy up your PC — locally, safely

advisor.title: System Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Reads the system and suggests a plan
advisor.scan_hint: Reads installed apps, processes, services, and startup items
advisor.apply_none: Nothing to apply from the plan: run a scan first.
advisor.apply_note: Windows will open each app's own uninstaller — confirm inside each one.

cleaner.title: Cleaner
cleaner.scan_hint: Looks for temp files, caches, and junk
cleaner.choose_hint: After the scan, tick the categories — only the selected ones get deleted.

dedup.title: Photo Duplicates
dedup.subtitle: Finds duplicate and visually similar photos
dedup.folder_hint: Pick a folder to scan images inside
dedup.scan_hint: Uses exact hashes and perceptual hash (imagehash)

tweaks.title: Tweaks
tweaks.subtitle: Startup items and services — we read, we show, we change only with your word
tweaks.empty_backups: Nothing to roll back: no snapshots yet.
tweaks.status_hint: I'll read startup and services — without changing a thing.
tweaks.confirm_disable_note: The entry leaves startup; a snapshot is saved — bring it back with «Restore».
tweaks.confirm_restore_note: The entry returns to startup as it was.
tweaks.services_hint: Disabled one at a time, start mode only: a running service is not killed on the spot — the change applies after reboot. The previous mode is snapshotted and restorable.
tweaks.uwp_hint: Removed for your user only; the package stays staged in the system and comes back via Restore in seconds. Frameworks and system packages are never listed.
tweaks.confirm_service_note: The service start mode becomes Disabled; a running service keeps running until reboot. The previous mode is kept in a snapshot.
tweaks.confirm_uwp_note: The app is removed for your user; the package stays in the system and can be brought back via Restore.
tweaks.sys_hint: Toggles know their current state. Every change snapshots previous values first - roll back anytime via Restore below. High risk is labeled honestly.
tweaks.confirm_tweak_note: The tweak will be applied to the system; previous values are snapshotted - roll back via Restore.
tweaks.tweak_status: Tweak applied: {name}. Rollback lives in the Restore section.
tweaks.presets_hint: One-click packs: every tweak inside is snapshotted separately, rollback stays granular.
tweaks.preset_status: Pack applied: {done} of {total}. Per-tweak rollback in the Restore section.
tweaks.confirm_preset_note: The whole pack will be applied; each tweak snapshots its previous state.
tweaks.apps_hint: Via winget: tick what you need, it installs as a list. Internet required.
tweaks.apps_none: Nothing selected - tick at least one app.
tweaks.confirm_apps_note: Packages will download and install via winget; package agreements are accepted silently.
tweaks.act_hint: Bundled MAS scripts (HWID for Windows, Ohook for Office) plus a manual KMS path.
tweaks.confirm_activation_note: A third-party activation script (MAS) will run. Licensing services will be restarted; HWID does not work on evaluation editions.
tweaks.gpedit_hint: Install the Group Policy editor on Home editions via DISM. Takes a while.
tweaks.confirm_gpedit_note: Group Policy packages will be installed via DISM. A few minutes, no reboot needed.
tweaks.shutdown_set_status: Shutdown scheduled in {name} min. Cancel button is right there.
tweaks.confirm_timer_note: The PC will really shut down on the timer. Cancel via the Cancel button on this page.
tweaks.hidepart_note: Selected letters disappear from This PC (drives stay accessible by path). B and C are not offered - hiding them is asking for trouble. Explorer restart required.
tweaks.hidepart_empty: Nothing to hide: no drives besides the system one.
tweaks.recs_hint: For your hardware the rules suggest packs: {names}.

journal.title: Deletion journal
journal.cancelled: Cancelled — only part of it was removed.
journal.hint: Scan again — let's see what grew back.

confirm.title: Here is exactly what will be done
confirm.note: Check the list: the action starts only after your «yes».

lines.hello: Hi! I'm Clini. I'll show you what's going on with this machine and clean up — with almost no questions asked.
lines.advisor: Taking a look around. The advisor reads the system and offers a plan, and I'll point out anything that smells off.
lines.cleaner: Garbage is my element. Temp files and caches go to the Recycle Bin, not into nowhere.
lines.dedup: Photo duplicates mean the same picture in three copies. I'll find them and keep one.
lines.tweaks: Startup and services — easy there: I don't switch anything off without your word.
lines.settings: Theme, language, font — here we can take a breath. Phew.
lines.scan: Going down the list: programs, services, startup items…
lines.clean: Found some mess. Have a look at the list — I touch nothing without you.
lines.calm: Phew. Almost clean in here — but no slacking, there is still work to do.
lines.cancelled: Fine, I'm touching nothing. Say the word and we'll get back to it.
lines.panic: Will you look at all this! One bucket won't do the job — we need a plan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.font_note: The pixel font is a matter of taste — one click switches back to default.
settings.sounds_note: Short blips on clicks, section changes and finished work.
settings.backup_info: Backups are stored locally and kept only for rollback.
settings.ollama_note: Later — local advisor with Ollama. Not active yet.
settings.ai_hint: Ollama - any model you pulled (ollama pull ...). API - your key, your model, your endpoint. Disabled - the advisor speaks by rules, offline.
settings.ai_remote_warn: Your data will leave this machine. Enable only if that is deliberate.
settings.ai_test_ok: Connection is alive, models in catalog: {count}.
settings.ai_test_ping: Server responds but the model catalog is unavailable - type the model manually.
settings.ai_test_fail: No connection. Check the address; for Ollama - is «ollama serve» running and a model pulled?
settings.ai_save_fail: AI settings did not save: no write access to the profile folder.

session.core_missing: Scan core not found: build rust/swagscan or place swagscan.exe next to the app.
session.lane_direct: no Recycle Bin, cannot be undone
session.purge_plan: Dry run: {count} items, {size} would be removed
session.purge_trashed: {size} in the Recycle Bin — space returns once it is emptied
session.scan_cancelled: Scan stopped: showing what was covered
session.nothing_to_clean: Scan first to find what to clean.
session.need_rescan: Too many items for one deletion — rescan and narrow the choice by categories.
session.dup_keep_note: The newest copy of each group is kept.
session.purge_real: Will delete {count} items, {size}. Lanes are decided by the core: some to the Recycle Bin, some permanently.

cats.old_large: Large files untouched for a long time
